root_cause.text: The `get_manuf_info()` function in the `io_ti` USB serial driver fails to validate that the device-provided descriptor size (`rom_desc->Size`) matches the size of the destination buffer (`struct edge_ti_manuf_descriptor`) before copying data via `read_rom()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (le16_to_cpu(rom_desc->Size) != sizeof(struct edge_ti_manuf_descriptor))` to reject unexpected lengths before calling `read_rom()`, preventing a heap overflow where up to 16377 bytes could be read into a 10-byte buffer.
